issue.title: Bug:[dhcp_mon]Compilation error by absence of include <algorithm>

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

src/dhcp_mon.cpp: In function 'void update_cache_counter(int, short int, void*)':
src/dhcp_mon.cpp:164:14: error: 'replace' is not a member of 'std'
  164 |         std::replace(counter_json.get()->begin(), counter_json.get()->end(),'\'', '\"');
      |              ^~~~~~~
Finished building: src/util.cpp

Finished building: src/main.cpp

make[2]: *** [src/subdir.mk:31: src/dhcp_mon.o] Error 1
make[2]: *** Waiting for unfinished jobs....
Finished building: src/dhcp_devman.cpp

Finished building: src/dhcp_device.cpp

make[2]: Leaving directory '/sonic/src/dhcpmon'
dh_auto_build: error: make -j64 "INSTALL=install --strip-program=true" returned exit code 2
make[1]: *** [debian/rules:9: build] Error 25
make[1]: Leaving directory '/sonic/src/dhcpmon'
dpkg-buildpackage: error: debian/rules build subprocess returned exit status 2
[  FAIL LOG END  ] [ target/debs/bullseye/sonic-dhcpmon_1.0.0-0_amd64.deb ]
make: *** [slave.mk:736: target/debs/bullseye/sonic-dhcpmon_1.0.0-0_amd64.deb] Error 1

### Steps to Reproduce

target/debs/bullseye/sonic-dhcpmon_1.0.0-0_amd64.deb

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The absence of the header file <algorithm> causes std::replace to fail to find it. Simply add #include <algorithm> in dhcp_mon.cpp to solve the problem.

resolution.title: [dhcp_mon] Add missing #include <algorithm> for std::replace
resolution.description:
## Description
`std::replace` is used in `dhcp_mon.cpp` (line 171) but the required `<algorithm>` header was not included, causing compilation failures on some toolchains.

This patch adds the missing `#include <algorithm>`.

## Motivation
Fixes sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#23276

## Changes
- Added `#include <algorithm>` to `src/dhcp_mon.cpp`
